usage: agent-guard [-h] [--version] {init,api,content,context,path,digest,workflow,surface,mcp,drift,conformance,evidence-pack,report,render-report} ...

static repository guardrails for agent-touched repos

positional arguments:
  {init,api,content,context,path,digest,workflow,surface,mcp,drift,conformance,evidence-pack,report,render-report}
    init                print or write review-first starter guard files
    api                 URL-based API surface guard
    content             pattern-based content security guard
    context             agent context file guard
    path                path-name guard for private artifacts and env-file leaks
    digest              SHA-256 pin guard for safety-critical files
    workflow            workflow drift guard for declared repository gates
    surface             agent-facing repository surface inventory
    mcp                 static MCP configuration evidence
    drift               small policy/spec drift guard
    conformance         profile conformance over sanitized evidence
    evidence-pack       review evidence pack manifest
    report              emit sanitized evidence for reviews
    render-report       render an existing sanitized report JSON without rescanning

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit

usage: agent-guard init [-h] [--root ROOT] [--print] [--write] [--skip-existing] [--force] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT      repository root path
  --print          print the planned starter files without writing
  --write          write starter files; refuses existing files unless --force
  --skip-existing  with --write, preserve existing starter files and write only missing files
  --force          overwrite existing starter files when used with --write
  --json           emit JSON

usage: agent-guard api [-h] {check} ...

positional arguments:
  {check}
    check     scan a repository and fail on forbidden API usage

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

  --policy POLICY  YAML policy path
  --json           emit JSON

options:

  --policy POLICY       YAML policy path

  --since-ref SINCE_REF

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           repository root used for display-path scrubbing
  --report REPORT       agent-guard report JSON path
  --artifact ARTIFACT   optional repo-relative artifact path
  --agent-policy-audit-event AGENT_POLICY_AUDIT_EVENT
                        optional repo-relative agent-policy audit event artifact path
  --agent-policy-audit-event-profile AGENT_POLICY_AUDIT_EVENT_PROFILE
                        recognized profile agent-guard.public_agent_policy_audit_event.v1 for every attached audit event
  --json                emit JSON

usage: agent-guard report [-h] [--root ROOT] [--context-policy CONTEXT_POLICY] [--evidence-preset {recommended}] [--path-policy PATH_POLICY] [--content-policy CONTENT_POLICY] [--content-scan-dir CONTENT_SCAN_DIR] [--api-policy API_POLICY] [--digest-policy DIGEST_POLICY] [--workflow-policy WORKFLOW_POLICY] [--drift-check] [--drift-profile {minimal,recommended,strict}] [--drift-schema-version {v1,v2}] [--drift-base-ref DRIFT_BASE_REF] [--surface-delta-base-ref SURFACE_DELTA_BASE_REF] [--surface-inventory-version {v1,v2}] [--mcp-config-check] [--mcp-policy MCP_POLICY] [--conformance-profile {minimal,recommended,strict}] [--evidence-pack-manifest] [--agent-policy-audit-event AGENT_POLICY_AUDIT_EVENT] [--agent-policy-audit-event-profile AGENT_POLICY_AUDIT_EVENT_PROFILE] [--format {markdown,json,github-annotations,sarif}] [--output OUTPUT] [--stderr-summary]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           repository root path
  --context-policy CONTEXT_POLICY
                        agent context YAML policy path (default: .agent-guard/context-policy.yaml)
  --evidence-preset {recommended}
                        expand unset report options for a named adoption preset
  --path-policy PATH_POLICY
                        optional path YAML policy path for path-name evidence
  --content-policy CONTENT_POLICY
                        optional content YAML policy path for content evidence
  --content-scan-dir CONTENT_SCAN_DIR
                        repository-relative directory for content report evidence (registered mode only)
  --api-policy API_POLICY
                        optional API YAML policy path for API surface evidence
  --digest-policy DIGEST_POLICY
                        optional digest YAML policy path for drift evidence
  --workflow-policy WORKFLOW_POLICY
                        optional workflow YAML policy path for drift evidence
  --drift-check         include policy/spec drift evidence for README, workflow, and guard policy alignment
  --drift-profile {minimal,recommended,strict}
                        profile for --drift-check
  --drift-schema-version {v1,v2}
                        drift evidence schema version
  --drift-base-ref DRIFT_BASE_REF
                        optional git base ref passed to policy/spec drift evidence
  --surface-delta-base-ref SURFACE_DELTA_BASE_REF
                        optional git base ref used to embed sanitized PR surface delta evidence
  --surface-inventory-version {v1,v2}
                        surface inventory schema version embedded in the report
  --mcp-config-check    include static MCP configuration evidence derived from committed config metadata
  --mcp-policy MCP_POLICY
                        optional MCP YAML policy path; implies --mcp-config-check
  --conformance-profile {minimal,recommended,strict}
                        embed conformance evidence
  --evidence-pack-manifest
                        embed a sanitized evidence pack manifest for PR review
  --agent-policy-audit-event AGENT_POLICY_AUDIT_EVENT
                        optional repo-relative agent-policy audit event artifact path for the embedded evidence-pack manifest
  --agent-policy-audit-event-profile AGENT_POLICY_AUDIT_EVENT_PROFILE
                        recognized profile agent-guard.public_agent_policy_audit_event.v1 for every attached audit event
  --format {markdown,json,github-annotations,sarif}
                        report output format
  --output OUTPUT       optional output path; stdout when omitted
  --stderr-summary      emit one sanitized stderr summary after writing --output

usage: agent-guard render-report [-h] [--root ROOT] --input INPUT [--format {markdown,json,github-annotations,sarif}] [--output OUTPUT]

options:

  --input INPUT         sanitized agent-guard report JSON path
  --format {markdown,json,github-annotations,sarif}
                        rendered output format
  --output OUTPUT       optional output path; stdout when omitted
